Title: Generally available: Azure Stream Analytics in four new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available in four new regions:

  • China East 3
  • China North 3
  • US DoD East
  • US Gov Texas

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 52 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
